reviewer_scope: Independently read all 136 current nonretail paragraphs and all 95 distinct exact cited own-date headline records, including Polish-language records. Checked concrete assertion scope, source age by meaning, actual release availability, company roles, previews versus outcomes, inference, locally supported synthesis and consistent actions. Compared every quoted market and Treasury level, return and yield change with the correct instrument, session, horizon, unit and split context. Read current-date source and release exclusions; none is cited. Re-read each named edited string. No Aug29 or later input was read before this acceptance.

limits: Evidence consists of exact dated headline records and current-vintage historical market cards, not full publisher article bodies or original unrevised data vintages.
